title: Great idea, but my cat did not love it
text: I think this is a great idea and would work well for the less picky kitties or if you have multiple cats.  I got four toys and a snack in this pack.  Apparently my cat is picky and refused to eat the snack, but that's okay.  However, two of the toys are basically the same and not very exciting.  One of them has nip, but doesn't have a lot of volume to it (it was a flat toy), and the fourth was a hanging toy which is great because my cat loves swinging things, but what's hanging beneath are not very exciting so he got tired of it soon.  I think if you have more cats with various tastes, you will have better luck with the toys, but with one cat, it's more of a hit or miss.
label: positive
